kind: Embedded browser exchange, short-lived exact-account sessions, durable resume and explicit held-file release
qualification_scope: Assisted same-host browser/CLI/API controls with real PostgreSQL and disk; complete journeys remain open. Final packaging removed one extra blank line at the end of dependency notices; all executable Go/SQL/TypeScript/JavaScript and styles remain identical to the broader serial regression.

environment.postgresql: 16.15, retained task-owned loopback fixture; real disposable integration databases and non-owner runtime without BYPASSRLS
environment.storage: Private actual local disk; synthetic business CSV, actual durable checkpoint/restart
environment.browser_tls: Explicit fixture SPKI pin; browser sandbox enabled; no global ignoreHTTPS/certificate-store changes
environment.assistance: Agent-prepared identities/configuration and scripted same-host browser journey, not independent human onboarding or adoption
environment.resource_policy: Serial checks; one browser at a time; GOMAXPROCS=1. Node uses a 192 MiB V8 heap target, not a process RSS cap. No inference or AV database loaded.

mechanisms: Reviewed React/TypeScript assets embedded into Go with exact source/output hashes, explicit asset allowlist, strict CSP, escaped text and no CDN or runtime Node requirement.

Enrolled bearer creates at most eight active sessions per actor. Purpose-separated standard HMAC-SHA256 derives opaque browser/CSRF credentials. SQL stores only hashes; protected application buffers are cleared with documented browser/HTTP library copy limits.

HttpOnly/Secure/SameSiteStrict host cookie; current parent credential hash, mount, authority revision, expiry and state rechecked by ordinary service transactions and bounded reads. Explicit bearer never falls back to a different cookie identity. Cookie mutations require exact HTTPS origin and CSRF.

Login replay retains original absolute lifetime of at most ten minutes. Logout atomically commits immutable command meaning, events and revocation. Reused key cannot revoke another session; receipt failure rolls everything back. Expired/revoked cookies have only a private close/replay capability, never general file authority.

Actor-private ticket discovery uses UUID keyset pagination, current mount/authority filtering and a boolean for older inaccessible open work without exposing paths. UI/API/CLI use the same bounded service.

One 1 MiB source slice at a time in the hashing worker; durable server offset drives progress. Pause aborts the request; reselecting the complete source checks exact length/digest before resuming the missing suffix. No automatic destination replacement.

Held acceptance, required checks and separate exact source/policy/report/revision release use existing current access and immutable-byte guards. A passing check alone does not release. Missing/unavailable scanner never becomes clean.

Native browser download streams through ordinary authorized storage/release checks. Safe virtual basename becomes attachment filename. No whole-file JavaScript Blob; pre-stream browser errors are readable escaped pages while API clients keep JSON.

migration_notes.row_lock_resolution: Opaque lookup is read-only. Verify parent identity, set that actor for its own session lock and recheck live proof; no credential UPDATE privilege granted. Every scoped transaction locks all 33 domain relations before forced-RLS verification.
